stem: 以下哪项是金融情报机构(FIU)的核心职能,如金融行动特别工作组(FATF)第29号建议所述？

options.A: 资助先进科技监控工具的研发，以供全国使用
options.B: 起诉属于国家管辖范围内的重大洗钱或恐怖融资案件
options.C: 与私营部门共享从国家执法机构收集到的实时犯罪情报
options.D: 充当全国可疑活动收集与分析中心

stem.text: 以下哪项是金融情报机构(FIU)的核心职能,如金融行动特别工作组(FATF)第29号建议所述？

alias_hits.review_note: FATF is the widely recognized abbreviation for Financial Action Task Force; 金融行动特别工作组 is the official Chinese translation.
FIU is the standard abbreviation for Financial Intelligence Unit; the Chinese variants refer to the same concept with minor translation differences.

option_A.text: 资助先进科技监控工具的研发，以供全国使用

option_B.text: 起诉属于国家管辖范围内的重大洗钱或恐怖融资案件

alias_hits.review_note: All listed English terms are used interchangeably to refer to the financing of terrorism, and they map to the same Chinese term 恐怖融资.

option_C.text: 与私营部门共享从国家执法机构收集到的实时犯罪情报

alias_hits.review_note: LEA is the abbreviation for law enforcement agency/agencies; 'law enforcement' is commonly used as a metonym for the agencies and maps to the same Chinese term 执法机构.

option_D.text: 充当全国可疑活动收集与分析中心
